title: Flow Of Energy In Ecosystem
definition: The unidirectional transfer of energy through trophic levels in an ecosystem, governed by the laws of thermodynamics, starting from solar radiation and dissipating as metabolic heat.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to Environment & Ecology (GS-III). Frequently tested via conceptual MCQs on trophic efficiency, bioaccumulation, and ecological pyramids.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Flow Of Energy In Ecosystem.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
